name: Planetkillerz: death of a world in five acts.
source:
The world is ending. But it's not as scary as you think. Well, maybe it is.

We all make choices in life. Except most of those choices are not within the context of the apocalypse. Meet the staff of the Department of Pre-Apocalypse and Post-Apocalyptic Affairs: Arthur, Iris, Oliver, two of the Four Horsemen of the Apocalypse, and others. Their job is to make sure the transition from one way of life to another is as smooth as possible... you know, as smooth as an apocalypse can be. Their latest assignment is a doozy - a new Great Flood that is going to wipe the planet clean. A daunting task for anyone, and these anyones just happen to have a metric boatload of emotional baggage. Will they get their collective stuff together in time to pull of a perfect end-of-the-world?

That's up to you.

You get to make the decisions that will shape our heroes. You get to choose how they will react to the moments that will stay with them forever. Taking each of their lives into your hands, you get to make their choices for them, for better or for worse. It's part adventure game, part visual novel.

How will you end the world?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1811920/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
世界就要毁灭了。但这并没有你想的那么可怕。好吧，也许还是有的。

人生中，我们总得作出选择。不过，大多数选择都与世界末日无关。来认识一下末日前后事务部的员工们吧，有亚瑟、艾瑞丝、奥利弗，还有天启四骑士中的两位，以及其他同事。他们的工作，是确保一种生活方式向另一种生活方式的过渡尽可能平稳……你懂的，至少在世界末日里尽量平稳。他们最新的任务可不简单——一场新的大洪水将把整颗星球冲刷干净。这对任何人都是艰巨的工作，偏偏这群人还各自背着一大堆情感包袱。他们能及时振作起来，同心协力，办成一场完美的世界末日吗？

那就由你决定了。

你将作出塑造这些主人公的决定，选择他们如何回应那些将铭记终生的时刻。每个人的人生都掌握在你手中，无论结果是好是坏，都由你替他们抉择。本作融合了冒险游戏与视觉小说的玩法。

你会怎样终结这个世界？

[译自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1811920/]Steam[/url]]
